strings.zh: 挺不错的嘛⋯⋯{NEWLINE}虽然是撞大运,{CLEAR}不过能赢我已经是不错了⋯⋯{SCROLL}我很喜欢你！{NEWLINE}告诉我你的电话号码吧！{SCROLL}我让你做我的练习对手！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Not too shabby... You’re doing{NEWLINE}something right if you can beat me,{CLEAR}even by an unlikely fluke...{SCROLL}I like you!{NEWLINE}Give me your number!{SCROLL}You can be my practice partner! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 别以为赢了我{NEWLINE}你就能得意了⋯⋯{CLEAR}你只是撞大运了而已！
strings.en: Don’t get too high and mighty{NEWLINE}about beating me! It was a fluke!

strings.zh: 难以置信！{NEWLINE}连交换都不知道！
strings.en: Unbelievable! You don’t even{NEWLINE}know how to trade numbers!

strings.zh: 告诉我你的电话号码吧！{SCROLL}我让你来做我的{NEWLINE}练习对手！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Give me your phone number!{SCROLL}You are going to be{NEWLINE}my practice partner!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 难不成⋯⋯你也喜欢{NEWLINE}２７号道路？{SCROLL}我当然也喜欢了！{SCROLL}所以我才一直在{NEWLINE}２７号道路上啊。
strings.en: What are you saying?{NEWLINE}You really like Route 27?{SCROLL}I do too, of course!{SCROLL}I mean, I’m always on Route 27!

strings.zh: 我说⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你还记得我的{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:10}吗？{SCROLL}没错,就是那个美丽的{VAR:0100:10}！{NEWLINE}你不觉得和我很配？{SCROLL}我挂啦！
strings.en: Listen, pal of mine...{NEWLINE}Do you remember my {VAR:0100:10}?{SCROLL}Yes, exactly. That lovely {VAR:0100:10}.{NEWLINE}Wouldn’t you agree it’s a perfect match{CLEAR}for me?{SCROLL}Fine, you may go.

strings.zh: 什么⋯⋯我跟{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}战斗过吗？{SCROLL}当然了！{SCROLL}区区{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}我都不知道打倒多少个了！{SCROLL}我挂啦！
strings.en: Have I ever faced a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}? You need to ask?{SCROLL}I’ve beaten {VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}on numerous occasions!{SCROLL}Fine, you may go.

strings.zh: 什么⋯⋯我有没有{NEWLINE}让精灵逃掉过？{SCROLL}当然了！{SCROLL}我怎么可能会让区区的{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}逃掉！
strings.en: What... have I ever let{NEWLINE}a Pokémon get away?{SCROLL}Of course not!{SCROLL}As if I’d ever let a mere{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} get away from me!
strings.notes: US 0698/9; ext-review RCA-028 | Hack text error fixed with user approval (D-1369, D-1496).

strings.zh: 来对战吧！{SCROLL}地点是{VAR:0104:3}！{NEWLINE}赶紧来吧！听好了吗！
strings.en: We are going to battle!{SCROLL}The place shall be {VAR:0104:3}!{NEWLINE}Don’t keep me waiting! Got it?

strings.zh: 你干什么呢！{NEWLINE}地点是{VAR:0104:3}！{CLEAR}你可别逃了啊！
strings.en: What are you doing?{SCROLL}I told you that the place was{CLEAR}{VAR:0104:3}! Don’t try to run!

strings.zh: 别以为赢了我{NEWLINE}就能得意了⋯⋯{CLEAR}你那只是撞大运而已！
strings.en: Don’t be too proud just because you{NEWLINE}happened to beat me...{CLEAR}It was a fluke!
